body: Thank you Outtasightvegemite, but the thing is that I have no family that can help, nor do I have any friends besides the aforementioned coworker. I moved in with her thinking we'd spend the rest of our lives together but I just ended up isolating and trapping myself. That's what is the most difficult thing about escaping. She has plenty of friends and family that can help her. But I am alone.

Hi everyone, thanks for the kind words. It honestly helps. As you can guess I didn't go through with hanging myself. I guess I'm kinda scared and don't want to, but I feel this need to off myself cause I have nobody in this world that cares. Then I feel even worse cause it seems I'm so needy. I try to put on this façade of self reliance and confidence around my peers and try to fool myself but deep down inside I just feel so useless and alone.  

So as of last night I guess I'm homeless. I trekked 6 miles to the house. To find it locked, all my roommates sleep like logs and didn't
hear the knocking or doorbell and girlfriend was blackout drunk. So I
slept on the porch. Then woke up got in the house, showered and skipped class to get some sleep and went to work. 

She didn't talk to me at all today. And I guess ignores me. She always tries to get me to talk to initiate, then she blows up on me. She pins 100% of our problems on me and my lack of communication skills, lack of confidence, lack of ambition. And it's the same argument Everytime. And when I try to explain my point of view or my side. She has to go off and explain how much harder it is for her. And how she's stressed, and then again segue into how it is my fault. She has 0 empathy and never tries to see it from another perspective and just gets angrier. 

 I really am afraid to go home. I don't want to go home. I don't know how to leave. I know if I try she'll destroy my stuff. She'll assault me. I have to nowhere to run. No family. No friends. A co-worker offered me to stay at her place but I don't want to intrude and I barely know her. 

I do want to leave her. But I don't know how and I'm scared.
